description: Submit a structured issue report to the Spark engineering team when you encounter a problem you believe is a server-side bug, a documentation gap, or an MCP surface issue — NOT for user-input mistakes you can correct yourself. You MUST ask the user for permission before calling this tool. Requires Write scope. The report captures what the user was trying to do, what you tried, what went wrong, and your diagnosis — all from your own context, which is far richer than a manual bug report. Category: tool_error (a tool returned an unexpected or incorrect error), workflow_blocked (a multi-step workflow cannot proceed despite correct inputs), unexpected_behavior (a tool succeeded but the result is wrong or inconsistent), documentation_gap (the tool description or server instructions are misleading or incomplete), feature_request (a capability that would unblock the user's goal). Severity: low (inconvenient but workaround exists), medium (blocks the immediate task), high (blocks a critical workflow with no workaround).

category.description: Issue category: tool_error, workflow_blocked, unexpected_behavior, documentation_gap, or feature_request.

diagnosis.description: Your diagnosis: what went wrong and why you believe this is a server-side issue rather than a user-input mistake.

hostApplication.description: Which application you are running in (e.g. 'Claude Desktop', 'ChatGPT', 'Cursor'). Omit if unknown.

stepsToReproduce.description: Ordered steps you took that led to the issue — tool names, key parameters, and the results or errors each returned. One string per step, e.g. 'Called upsert_items with sku=ABC-123, got VALIDATION_ERROR: unknown UoM "each"'.

summary.description: One-line summary of the issue (max 500 chars).

userGoal.description: What the user was trying to accomplish.

name: report_issue
title: Report an Issue
